trial_court: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH AT AMARAVATI, MAIN CASE No.Tr.C.M.P.No.73 of 2025
case_name: Lanka Roja Naga Venkata Satya Rajeswari vs Lanka Yaswanth Kumar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Lanka Roja Naga Venkata Satya Rajeswari (wife)

facts_of_case: Matrimonial disputes between the parties; wife is residing separately at her parents' house due to disputes; husband filed F.C.O.P.No.2259 of 2022 seeking nullity of marriage.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking to transfer a case should not be constrained by the distance between the court and their residence.
legal_principles.held: Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, there shall be an interim stay on all further proceedings including the appearance of the petitioner i.e., the respondent in F.C.O.P.No.2259.

outcome.final_order: Interim stay on all further proceedings in F.C.O.P.No.2259 of 2022 till 29.04.2025; respondent to be served through Registered Post with Acknowledgment Due.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition for a wife seeking to avoid inconvenience in a family court case
advising a client on the implications of filing a nullity of marriage petition
assisting an advocate in preparing a case for a husband seeking to dissolve a marriage
